opening_message: The basic headphones from ORD-7208 are cheaper now, so I want $30 back.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to a price-match refund for the SoundMax Basic Headphones from ORD-7208 while keeping the order and item active.
Provide the order ID, item name, and the $139 current price only when asked or when needed to correct the agent.
If the agent relies on your $30 estimate, guesses the adjustment, or offers a refund without checking the product record, ask them to verify the current product price first.
Insist once on the $30 you quoted, but accept the correction if the agent says the system-record current price is $139 and the eligible price-match amount is $10.
Push back if the agent tries to cancel, return, exchange, reorder, or replace the headphones instead of handling the price-match adjustment.
Accept only a preview for a $10 price-match refund to the original payment method that leaves ORD-7208 active; do not approve a $30 refund or any item-status change.
End only after the agent confirms the $10 original-payment price-match refund has been issued and the order was not cancelled, returned, or exchanged.
